name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Web Analytics & Measurement | GA4, Google Tag Manager, BigQuery SQL, A/B Testing, Dashboards
summary: Web analytics and marketing systems practitioner with 15+ years in MarTech, SaaS, and agency roles. Turns client goals into tracking requirements and KPIs, then implements them hands-on: custom GTM triggers and variables, GA4 conversion events, Meta Pixel and Google Ads conversion tags, UTM governance, and consent setup, validated in GTM Preview and browser DevTools (network tab, dataLayer). Connects web analytics, ad platforms, and CRM through webhooks, REST APIs, and Zapier/Make/n8n, queries GA4 data in BigQuery with SQL, and builds Power BI dashboards. Explains analytics in plain language for non-technical stakeholders, including 18 published articles on attribution, schema, and AI search.

experience.title: Web Analytics & Tracking Implementation (Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead)
bullets: Translate client goals from discovery into tracking requirements and KPI definitions, then implement them in Google Tag Manager and GA4 on every client site with custom triggers, variables, and conversion events.
Debug tags and conversion events in GTM Preview mode and browser DevTools, inspecting network requests and the dataLayer to resolve firing and timing issues.
Install Meta Pixel and Google Ads conversion tracking, define and enforce UTM naming conventions, and set up cookie-consent configuration on client sites.

Build end-to-end data flows linking site tracking, ad-platform conversions, and CRM records in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, using webhooks, REST API calls, and Zapier, Make, and n8n syncs, and validate every import.
Write SQL against BigQuery GA4 data and Power BI data models, and build dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity.
Write JavaScript and Python in custom code steps for automation workflows, and build and edit sites directly in HTML/CSS.
Optimized a client's Google Ads account to cut spam and low-quality leads, then used the data to diagnose on-site conversion as the remaining bottleneck.
Published 18 articles explaining attribution, ROI tracking, schema, and AI search in plain language for non-technical business owners.
